notes: SMARTTRAFFIC: LUU PAYLOAD BAI LOI 5xx DE DANG LAI (truoc day bi mat). Hien tuong: server SmartTraffic 500 keo dai >3,5 phut (da thu lai 4 lan cach 20/40/60/80s van 500), tool dung dung nhu thiet ke nhung TRUYEN BI MAC KET: nut 'Dang lai bai loi' chi quet Adsconex (find_pending_adsconex) nen khong nhat duoc bai SmartTraffic, va cung khong co file pending nao duoc ghi cho SmartTraffic. Da them: SMARTTRAFFIC_PENDING_FILE = publish_pending_smarttraffic.json; smarttraffic_write_pending() ghi payload khi het luot thu ma van 5xx; smarttraffic_clear_pending() xoa khi dang thanh cong; find_pending_smarttraffic() liet ke bai chua dang duoc (bo qua bai da co publish_result.json co url); republish_pending_smarttraffic() dang lai voi cung co che thu lai 20/40/60/80s + doi ten video. Nut 'Dang lai bai loi' va buoc dang lai cuoi batch nay hoat dong theo NET dang chon: Adsconex -> find_pending_adsconex, SmartTraffic -> find_pending_smarttraffic. Da test 5 tinh huong: chua co pending -> []; ghi pending -> nhat duoc dung payload; bai da dang roi -> khong nhat nua; dang lai thanh cong (500,500,201) -> xoa pending + ghi publish_result.json; server van 500 -> GIU pending de bam lai sau. GUI build OK, config khong bi ghi de.
